title: Act One/Inspiration
html:
Overview Approval Inspiration

This page contains all known inspirations which can be earned in Act One of Baldur's Gate 3.

To unlock an inspiration, the character with corresponding background must be in the active party. If there are more than one party member with the same background, each of them earns an inspiration point once the conditions fit. This can be used to replenish the inspiration points' pool quickly if needed.

If none of the player characters have a background fit for obtaining an inspiration point, this can be solved by asking Withers to summon a hireling with a corresponding background. The set of characters offered for hire provides the full scope of backgrounds, except the Haunted One, which is unique for the Dark Urge.

Dialogues

  • Cub must be spared in the Owlbear Nest and saved from the Goblin Camp. The inspiration is given after the cub comes to the camp for the second time (with a wounded paw) and if it then stays as a Camp Follower.

  • Alfira appears in the camp if she was not previously knocked out in the Sacred Pool. Regardless what is said or done, the Dark Urge butchers Alfira. If Quil Grootslang appears instead of Alfira, the inspiration does not trigger.

  • Despite the description, this inspiration is given after talking to Volo in the camp, if he was invited to join.

 Sir Fuzzalump 		⁠Dank Crypt

 Barth

 Sir Fuzzalump 		⁠Frescos Learn local history from the druidic frescos.

Triumph over the mother Owlbear.

Reforge the broken spear.

Blighted Village

Schoolhouse

 A Mother's Loathing
 Heart of Stone

Drink one of Ethel's unique potions.
  • Of all potions, these two are recommended to use, as they are the only ones which have positive effects.
  • This inspiration can also be earned in Act Three in The Blushing Mermaid Basement, if Ethel resides there.

Bugs

  • To earn Eldritch Authority inspiration, must use illithid persuasion 7 times. However, the game can bug and apply "True Soul" tag earlier than intended.
  • Due to a coding bug, the Natural Alliance inspiration does not trigger if the Dark Urge character interacts with the skeletons.
